prompt:
小红书文字型社媒卡。排版：左上放置一个醒目的双引号，中间呈现主题文案并将关键词重点化，右下放置一条下划线；句末可以添加与文字大小适配的 emoji。保持文字主导的简洁构图。

本次输入：【填写画幅、标题、主视觉、各区短文案】。
有事实、名称、数字或引文时，按输入使用；信息缺失的模块留空或省略。
promptEnglish:
Xiaohongshu text-led social-media card. Layout: place a prominent opening quotation mark in the upper-left, present the theme copy in the center with key words emphasized, and add an underline in the lower-right. An emoji may appear at the end of the sentence, sized to match the text. Keep the composition simple and typography-led.

Inputs: [Provide aspect ratio, headline, main visual, and short copy for each section].
Use supplied facts, names, numbers and quotations. Leave sections without data blank or omit them.
